concepts.title: 喂 (wéi) — Hello on the Phone
concepts.explanation: 喂 is used when answering or starting a phone call.
concepts.note: Use 喂 mainly for phone conversations, not formal face-to-face greetings.

concepts.title: 给 (gěi) with 打电话 (dǎ diànhuà)
concepts.explanation: Use 给 to show whom you are calling.
concepts.note: Another common order is 我打电话给妈妈。

concepts.title: 在……呢 for Ongoing Phone Actions
concepts.explanation: Use 在……呢 to show an action is happening right now.
concepts.example_pinyin: Tā zài gěi péngyou dǎ diànhuà ne.
concepts.example_en: She is calling her friend right now.
concepts.note: 在 marks ongoing action, 呢 adds a natural continuous tone.

concepts.title: 打错了 (dǎ cuò le) — Called the Wrong Number
concepts.explanation: 打错了 means you dialed the wrong number.

concepts.title: 在家 (zài jiā) — At Home
concepts.explanation: 在家 means 'to be at home'.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ zài gěi shéi dǎ diànhuà?
Wǒ zài gěi yīshēng dǎ diànhuà.
Méiyǒu zhège rén, nǐ dǎ cuò le.
grammar.en: There is no such person, you called the wrong number.

grammar.pinyin: Tā wǎnshang bā diǎn bàn qián huí jiā.
grammar.en: He will come home before 8:30 PM.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn bàn hòu dǎ diànhuà.
